snippet.title: Dead by Daylight | Chorus of Sin | Story Trailer
snippet.description:
The time has come to face judgement for your choices.

Step into the world of divine horror in Dead by Daylight's first community-created Chapter. Play as The Judgement, an otherworldly Killer sent by the Celestial Echelon to cleanse the world in flame, and Aurora Stardotter, a resolute Survivor using her gift of star-reading to lead her people out of the ashes.   

Dead by Daylight: Chorus of Sin, Coming August 25!

Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming's best asymmetrical multiplayer.     

PLAY DEAD BY DAYLIGHT: https://buythegame.deadbydaylight.com/   

Join the official forum:  https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/
